title: Lilleys' Landing Resort & Marina
specs: Dock has three fish cleaning stations, two indoors heated in winter, one outdoors
Dock is covered, well lit, with fishing piers and chairs
If born after January 1, 1984, must have Missouri boater certification card to operate motorized boat
includes: Gas is free with boat rental
gap: Age minimum for boat rental not stated
blurb: Guests can stay in lakefront rooms and cabins on Lake Taneycomo, rent fishing boats equipped for trout fishing, and use the on-site fly shop. The marina offers pontoon, bass, and jon boat rentals for fishing or cruising. The dock has fish cleaning stations and boat stalls for resort guests.
extraNote: Boat stalls available only to resort guests at $15 per night including sales tax
